metadata.title: Assistant session history review
metadata.description: Review known Claude and Codex conversation locations. These are valuable records, not disposable cache.

insights.title: Review Claude project history
insights.subject: directory
insights.detail: Recorded project conversations may be valuable. Review and back up anything you need; use the owning tool's supported history controls. Custom profiles are not discovered.

insights.title: Review Codex session history
insights.subject: directory
insights.detail: Recorded sessions can contain valuable conversation history. Review and back up anything you need. This pack does not classify history as junk or discover custom CODEX_HOME locations.
